title: 15.65. Arūpāvacaraduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Arūpāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naarūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Naarūpāvacaraṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naarūpāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Naarūpāvacaraṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca naarūpāvacaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ. (Abyākatamūlaṁ dve paccayavasena.)
